svg.text: STAGE 395 · TOPIC 35 FAQ
Edge SBC/HSM NIST FF1 Tokenization & Authenticated RTP Latching
NIST SP 800-38G FF1 Zero-Plaintext Cloud Scope (P783) & RFC 4961 Anti-RTP-Bleed Latching + RFC 5761 rtcp-mux (P784)
1. Edge SBC/HSM NIST FF1 Tokenization Gate (P783)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Post-ASR Regex Redaction & UUID Schema Breakage
• Raw 16-digit PAN/SSN enters cloud ASR/LLM memory before regex scrubbing
• Replacing 16-digit PAN with 36-char UUID crashes legacy COBOL/SAP fields
• Result: Entire AI cluster dragged into PCI-DSS CDE audit & ERP schema crash
✅ Production Pattern: Edge SBC + HSM NIST SP 800-38G FF1 FPE (P783)
1. DMZ Edge Interception: Intercept PAN/SSN at SBC before cloud AI ingress
2. NIST FF1 Format-Preserving Token: Keep 4-1-1-4 format & Luhn check digit
3. Sub-5ms Hardware HSM: FIPS 140-3 L3 HSM tokenizes in <=5ms with 0 leaks
4. Zero Cloud CDE Scope: Cloud LLM processes synthetic FF1 tokens safely
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateEdgeSbcHsmNistFf1Format...):
clampedPlaintextPanDigitsInCloud == 0 && clampedHsmTokenizeLatencyMs <= 5ms
2. RFC 4961 Anti-RTP-Bleed Latching & rtcp-mux (P784)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Blind First-Packet RTP Latching (RTP Bleed) & 2-Port Waste
• Attacker sprays 1 spoofed UDP packet to port 10000-20000 during NAT rebind
• Blind RFC 4961 symmetric RTP re-latches outbound voice to attacker's IP
• Result: Live call audio hijacked & dual RTP+RTCP ports halve SBC capacity
✅ Production Pattern: Crypto-Verified Latching + RFC 5761 rtcp-mux (P784)
1. Authenticated Latching Only: Require SRTP Auth Tag or STUN ufrag/pwd
2. Zero Blind Re-Latch: Drop unauthenticated NAT rebind packets in 0ms
3. RFC 5761 rtcp-mux: Multiplex RTP & RTCP on 1 UDP port per media stream
4. 2x Port Density & Anti-Hijack: Doubles SBC concurrency with 0 RTP Bleed
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSymmetricRtpRfc4961...):
unauthenticatedRtpRelatches == 0 && clampedUdpPortsPerStream == 1

• Edge FF1 Gate (P783): 0 plaintext PAN digits in cloud (<=5ms HSM); RTP Latching Gate (P784): 0 RTP Bleed hijacks & 1 UDP port/stream via rtcp-mux.
